_comment: G4 retrieval gold. SPLIT INTO dev AND holdout (A12): thresholds are calibrated on dev ONLY and measured on holdout, so the reported top-1 is not the number the thresholds were fitted to. Queries are grounded in services that exist in the corpus (passport/driving-licence do NOT exist on Dawlati and appear here only as deliberate out-of-scope cases). Arabic queries are a mix of fosha and Lebanese dialect in Arabic script, matching how citizens actually type; Arabizi is excluded by decision (detect_language misroutes it — see PROGRESS Findings 2026-07-27).
